attributes.name: Druva - Backup Policy Modified
attributes.description: Detects modifications to backup, retention, or recovery-related policies.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
meta.customer_usecase: Detects modifications to backup, retention, or recovery-related policies.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| EVAL event_text = TO_LOWER(
    COALESCE(
      TO_STRING(message),
      TO_STRING(message),
      TO_STRING(druva.event_type),
      ""
    )
  )

| WHERE
    event_text LIKE "*backup*policy*modif*"
    OR event_text LIKE "*backup*policy*updat*"
    OR event_text LIKE "*retention*policy*modif*"
    OR event_text LIKE "*retention*policy*updat*"

| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp

| EVAL actor = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(user.id),
    TO_STRING(user.name)
  )

| EVAL policy = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(druva.profile.name),
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name)
  )
